persons.name: Śaśidevātmaja
persons.evidence: likhitam ideṃ || ... dvijavara śrīsaśidevātmaja pravoddanārtha svaṃ pvaṣṭakaṃ

date.as_written: samvata 586(!) aśukla(!)pañcaṃmyāṃ tithau | jyeṣṭa(!) nakṣatre || somavāsare

place.as_written: śrīlaḍitabrumā śrīmānīgalake dakṣiṇata(!) || pitho valānihmaṃ yāmagṛhādi

purpose: pravoddanārtha svaṃ pvaṣṭakaṃ (for self-study/enlightenment, own book)
notes: The scribe refers to himself without personal name as the son of Śaśideva (dvijavara-śrī-śaśidevātmaja). 'aśukla' may denote the dark fortnight (kṛṣṇapakṣa) or represent a corrupted month name (e.g., Āśvina-śukla-).
